text:
alice: Heads-up: planning to run `terraform apply` for v2 release during today's change window (1600-1700 UTC). Need provider pin validation + rollback plan.

devon: +1. Which providers are we pinning? last-minute provider upgrades have bitten us before.

alice: We have aws ~> 4.60 -> pin to 4.59 in tflock, hashicorp/random unchanged. Also pin provider checksums in `required_providers` block.

sam: Can we do a micro-canary? apply to staging-az-a first, smoke tests, then serial across remaining AZs.

alice: Yes — plan: staging-az-a (canary), wait 10m, run smoke `scripts/smoke_infra.sh` and prometheus alert check, then serial apply with 1m gap.

tess: Make sure deploybot has the branch pin and the rollback playbook attached to the run. I will attach release notes + runbook in the ticket.
deploybot: Deploybot scheduled run queued: #3852 by alice. ETA: 1747658000. Preconditions: plan-approval, provider-pin-tag, smoke-check.

devon: Important: if any IAM change touches cross-account roles, abort and escalate. Last time an assume-role ARN typo removed delegated admins. Add a manual hold if `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment` > 0 changes.

alice: Good call. I added a plan hook to detect IAM attachment diffs and will gate the apply. Hook snippet:

```bash
# pre-apply check (pseudo)
if tfplan | grep aws_iam_role_policy_attachment; then
  echo "IAM attachment changes detected: require manual approval" && exit 2
fi
```

sam: For rollback: we should snapshot current state and export list of Terraform-managed critical ARNs. Also keep a record of previous module versions in the release notes.

tess: I'll put a quick rollback checklist in the ticket: revert module refs, restore tfstate from `s3://redwood-tfstate/backups/` (latest before apply), run `terraform apply -target=module.x` for emergency partial revert.

alice: Running `terraform plan` now and posting plan link. Will comment back with the plan URL and deploybot approval once ready.

devon: Also add a throttling policy to the deploybot run: max 2 concurrent applies to avoid AZ-wide blips.
deploybot: Note: automated throttling enabled: concurrency=2. Will post plan link when available. :rocket:

alice: Thanks all — I'll post updates in this thread. If anything looks risky abort and ping on-call. :thumbsup:
